svg.aria-label: AWS Databases overview. Your application answers three questions: the shape of the data, how you read it, and the guarantees you need. The answers pick one of eight data models managed by AWS: relational (RDS, Aurora, Aurora DSQL), key-value (DynamoDB), document (DocumentDB), wide-column (Keyspaces), in-memory (ElastiCache, MemoryDB), search (OpenSearch Service), graph (Neptune), and time series (Timestream for InfluxDB).
svg.title: AWS Databases: three questions pick one of eight data models and its AWS service
svg.text: Pick by the shape of your data
Eight data models, managed by AWS
